headline: Record assets and strong inflows lift economic earnings
summary_short: AMG's Q3 2026 Economic EPS was $9.50, up 56% y/y, and AUM reached a record $974 billion with $21 billion of net client inflows; GAAP diluted EPS fell to $6.64 from $6.87.
summary_long: Aggregate fees rose to $1.76 billion from $1.35 billion. Alternative strategies generated record net inflows of more than $31 billion in the quarter. Adjusted EBITDA (controlling interest) grew 41% to $354 million and Economic net income to $248 million. AMG repurchased $400 million of stock in the quarter, bringing year-to-date repurchases to $775 million. GAAP net income was lower at $173 million versus $212 million.
confidence_notes: Figures are read from the release's financial highlights table. GAAP net income and Economic net income move in opposite directions; the release's economic measures exclude non-cash and other items. No numeric guidance given.

drivers.explanation: Management points to strength in alternative strategies and net client cash flows of about $21 billion in the quarter, with disciplined capital allocation including share repurchases.
Average AUM rose to $956.9 billion from $786.9 billion, supported by $21 billion of net client cash flows in the quarter.
Not explained in the release; GAAP net income fell while Economic net income rose.
